description: Structured Pydantic schema for IndustryAnalysisAgent output.

industry_name.description: Formal name of the industry vertical.
industry_name.title: Industry Name

industry_description.description: Detailed description of the industry landscape.
industry_description.title: Industry Description

industry_classification.description: Standard industry classification taxonomy or sector grouping.
industry_classification.title: Industry Classification

industry_lifecycle_stage.description: Lifecycle stage of the industry (e.g. Emerging, Growth, Mature, Consolidation).
industry_lifecycle_stage.title: Industry Lifecycle Stage

industry_maturity.description: Maturity level rating of the overall industry.
industry_maturity.title: Industry Maturity

industry_growth_rate.description: Estimated qualitative or quantitative industry CAGR/growth rate trajectory.
industry_growth_rate.title: Industry Growth Rate

industry_drivers.description: Core macro and technological drivers spurring industry progression.
industry_drivers.title: Industry Drivers

industry_challenges.description: Structural or economic challenges facing companies in this industry.
industry_challenges.title: Industry Challenges

entry_barriers.description: Key barriers to entry for new market entrants.
entry_barriers.title: Entry Barriers

regulatory_environment.description: Overview of regulatory complexity, compliance requirements, and government oversight.
regulatory_environment.title: Regulatory Environment

technology_adoption.description: Level and speed of modern technology adoption across industry incumbents.
technology_adoption.title: Technology Adoption

innovation_level.description: Current innovation intensity and rate of technological disruption.
innovation_level.title: Innovation Level

investment_activity.description: Venture capital, private equity, and corporate M&A investment activity level.
investment_activity.title: Investment Activity

confidence_score.description: Confidence score rating strictly between 0.0 and 1.0.
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

citations.description: Source URLs backing the claims above, when external web research was supplied in the prompt. Optional and defaults empty so this schema stays backward compatible with LLM-only reasoning when no research bundle is available.
citations.title: Citations

title: IndustryAnalysis
